sanitization: Hostname replaced with lab-host, username with lab-user. Timestamps, rule data, and outcomes are unmodified.

environment.endpoint: WSL2 Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS, kernel 6.18.33.2-microsoft-standard-WSL2, Wazuh agent 4.14.8 (id 001)

attempts.procedure: One sudo authentication with a deliberately wrong password
attempts.endpoint_evidence: journald 10:32:12 sudo[637]: pam_unix(sudo:auth): authentication failure; ... user=lab-user
attempts.observed: No alert. Agent logged 'Agent stopped' at 10:32:30 and restarted at 10:33:43; journal entries written while the distro was stopping were not forwarded.
attempts.root_cause: WSL terminates an idle distro shortly after the last process exits, stopping the agent. Telemetry gap, not a detection gap.

attempts.precondition: Distro held online; agent 001 status 'active' confirmed via API before trigger
attempts.procedure: One sudo authentication with a deliberately wrong password

observed_alert.full_log: Oct 13 10:35:10 lab-host unix_chkpwd[657]: password check failed for user (lab-user)

limitations: Single event; no repeated-failure (brute-force) correlation tested.
Ubuntu 26.04 uses sudo-rs; Wazuh's classic sudo rules did not fire. Only the generic unix_chkpwd rule matched.
Index visibility time is bounded by the 5 s polling interval of the test.
